prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1348; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash-type loss of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is in keeping with the force and direction of the impact described. Over the course of care, the patient completed 21 visits that included manual therapy, guided range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced in step with recovery, following a typical course for this type of injury. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly support the diagnosis of a cervical soft tissue injury. The patient also reported a small strain in the same region several years earlier, which resolved completely and had no lasting effect on function before the collision. Billing records reflect the services rendered without repeated or duplicate charges. At discharge, the patient had regained most of the expected range of motion, reported minimal residual discomfort, and was advised to continue independent exercises as needed.
